mapper.select: SELECT id, refund_id, commission_record_id, order_id, order_no, agent_id, agent_user_id, agent_name, original_commission_amount, clawback_amount, deducted_amount, debt_amount, clawback_type, status, reason, create_time FROM dms_commission_clawback WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, refund_id, commission_record_id, order_id, order_no, agent_id, agent_user_id, agent_name, original_commission_amount, clawback_amount, deducted_amount, debt_amount, clawback_type, status, reason, create_time FROM dms_commission_clawback WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, refund_id, commission_record_id, order_id, order_no, agent_id, agent_user_id, agent_name, original_commission_amount, clawback_amount, deducted_amount, debt_amount, clawback_type, status, reason, create_time FROM dms_commission_clawback WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 2 AND debt_amount > 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(debt_amount), 0) FROM dms_commission_clawback WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND status = 2 AND debt_amount > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_commission_clawback (refund_id, commission_record_id, order_id, order_no, agent_id, agent_user_id, agent_name, original_commission_amount, clawback_amount, deducted_amount, debt_amount, clawback_type, status, reason) VALUES (#{refundId}, #{commissionRecordId}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{agentId}, #{agentUserId}, #{agentName}, #{originalCommissionAmount}, #{clawbackAmount}, #{deductedAmount}, #{debtAmount}, #{clawbackType}, #{status}, #{reason})
